description: This file defines a feature in a C# ASP.NET Core project related to retrieving user details by username. It includes a query request class, a validator for the query, and a handler that interacts with the database to fetch user data, generate a JWT token, and return an envelope containing user information.

classes.name: Details.Query
classes.description: A record representing the request to fetch user details by username.

classes.name: Details.QueryValidator
classes.description: Validator ensuring the username in the query is not null or empty.

classes.name: Details.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the fetching of user data from the database, token generation, and returning the user envelope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Asynchronously processes the query to retrieve user data, generates a JWT token, and wraps it in a UserEnvelope.
